dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: How about a team battle next time? Or maybe some kind of versus match? Oh, it's you guys! Welcome to the training ground!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: More and more folks have been showing up lately. That's all thanks to you. And of course, the kids and The Hollowhands did their part too!

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: I think the training ground might just be the perfect place for get-togethers. When you bump into someone you haven't seen in ages, it's hard to know where to start the conversation, right?

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: Ah... I still haven't found anything that works better than my targets for lining their nest...

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: The kids and I have tried all kinds of materials, but they just really like the targets. So for now, trading with them is still our only option...

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: But we've kinda cracked their treasure exchange rates, and we've been making a pretty good profit.

response.speaker: Vaino
response.text: You're welcome anytime! And remember, for you two, it'll always be free!

dialogues.speaker: Vaino
dialogues.text: You've been a big help! I'll keep what you and little Sisko said in mind. Here's hoping more and more folks come by!
